target: Within each training signal date, strict eligible finite y_excess_5d samples only: relevance=min(9,floor(10*(average_rank(y)-0.5)/n)). Ties keep equal relevance. All tied returns have one relevance and no pairwise ranking signal. No global quantile estimates or future-period labels.
groups: Sort by signal_date and PERMNO before masking; each contiguous signal date is one query. Missing/unverified or boundary-crossing targets excluded before computing relevance. Inference still covers all eligible stocks regardless of target availability.
shared_fixed: All other estimator settings copied from frozen round2 lightgbm_fixed, including 100 trees, min_child_samples=500, learning_rate=.03, L2=1, seed=20261107. No early stopping.
preprocessing: Reuse exact round2 per-window original/enhanced LightGBM preprocessing states and saved development feature snapshot; do not fit new transforms.
selection: Equal weight mean across the two windows of equal-date Rank IC against continuous y_excess_5d; choose separately for original/enhanced features; exact ties choose lower candidate index. Save selection before portfolio evaluation.
diagnostics: NDCG at ceil(n/10) with linear relevance and predicted ties ordered by PERMNO; top-decile continuous label mean on eligible scored stocks, then strict-label filtering; yearly IC; matched-leaf comparisons with saved round2 regression results. NDCG and portfolio returns never select candidates.
portfolio: 2020-2021 only; replay selected window2 rankers under original top-decile and unchanged round1 constrained rules. Compare to saved round2 portfolios without retraining/replaying regression models.
interpretation: Development and selection diagnostics, not independent confirmation. This experiment changes both loss and discrete target representation; it cannot isolate pure loss effect. No 2022-2025 performance reads or model selection.
